resist.note: while in dim light or darkness

trait.name: Life Hunger
entries: If a creature within 60 feet of the sorrowsworn regains hit points, the sorrowsworn gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its Bite deals an extra 22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage on a hit.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sorrowsworn makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 16}), and it is {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the sorrowsworn can't make a Claw attack.

Horrible creatures with grasping claws and distended jaws, hungry sorrowsworn—also known as the Hungry—do whatever is necessary to sate their appetites. These greedy devourers stuff their maws with flesh and drink in their victims' screams. When they finish, they lurch away while their bright eyes resume the search for something else to consume.
